comments: Version 5.0.2 is the current public release. The project is free and open source under the MIT License. Automated results are evidence, not a conformance determination. The reports identify manual-review boundaries, and the documentation states that complete evaluation requires manual review, assistive-technology testing, and judgment about the content and its purpose.
features: Free, open-source command-line application for scanning websites, local HTML and CSS, and PDF documents. It combines static checks with optional Playwright and axe-core browser testing, produces HTML, JSON, and CSV reports, and identifies results that still require manual or assistive-technology review.
title: WCAG 2.2 Site and PDF Scanner
